verdict.rationale: Salesmate's own marketing says its AI can summarize conversations and support next-best actions using real customer context, which covers in-product insights and suggestions in principle. That support rests on one marketing line, with no detail on how it works or which data it uses. Missing for 10: detailed docs on AI insight and suggestion features (e.g. deal/pipeline insights, forecasting, data analysis), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI to assist teams, summarize conversations, automate repetitive work, support next-best actions, and improve execution using real customer context.
